declaration_verdict.note: stated (OK); relation different formulation; the auditor's reading: Same conclusion as theorem_1_1 for every nu > 0, with the extra clause u (t,x) = 0 and p (t,x) = 0 for all |t| <= 3/8. Strictly stronger than the paper's Theorem 1.1.

theorem theorem_1_1_with_initial_rest (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) :
    ∃ u : VelocityField, ∃ p : PressureField, ∃ f : VelocityField, ∃ K : Set Space,
      CandidateProperties ν u p f K ∧
      ¬ Nonempty (GlobalFiniteEnergySolution ν f) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 3 / 8 → ∀ x : Space,
        u (t, x) = 0 ∧ p (t, x) = 0
